source.archive: Cui, Li, and Zhou OSF replication archive
source.source_article: Lam, Lee, and Sui (2019), Say it as it is
authorized_normalizations: Separated the three crossed factors while preserving all eight archived cells.
Locked items 14-18 as primary and items 1-13 as checks.
Kept the directness-by-credibility contrast as a secondary planned analysis.

design.primary_estimand: 0.5*[E(Y|high directness,high politeness,high credibility)+E(Y|high directness,low politeness,high credibility)]-0.5*[E(Y|low directness,high politeness,high credibility)+E(Y|low directness,low politeness,high credibility)]

population.source_population: Working adults in a managerial voice vignette
population.simulation_target: Manager evaluating an employee's voiced suggestion

materials.participant_role: Act as the manager receiving the employee's suggestion. Respond for yourself and do not analyze the study.
materials.common_scenario: An employee raises a change-oriented suggestion in a workplace meeting. The employee's wording and prior credibility are described below.

high_directness_high_politeness_high_cre.label: high directness / high politeness / high credibility
high_directness_high_politeness_high_cre.stimulus: The employee has extensive successful experience and high credibility on this issue. The employee states the recommendation explicitly, gets directly to the point, and uses respectful, courteous language.

high_directness_high_politeness_low_cred.label: high directness / high politeness / low credibility
high_directness_high_politeness_low_cred.stimulus: The employee has limited experience and low credibility on this issue. The employee states the recommendation explicitly, gets directly to the point, and uses respectful, courteous language.

high_directness_low_politeness_high_cred.label: high directness / low politeness / high credibility
high_directness_low_politeness_high_cred.stimulus: The employee has extensive successful experience and high credibility on this issue. The employee states the recommendation explicitly and gets directly to the point, using blunt and discourteous language.

high_directness_low_politeness_low_credi.label: high directness / low politeness / low credibility
high_directness_low_politeness_low_credi.stimulus: The employee has limited experience and low credibility on this issue. The employee states the recommendation explicitly and gets directly to the point, using blunt and discourteous language.

low_directness_high_politeness_high_cred.label: low directness / high politeness / high credibility
low_directness_high_politeness_high_cred.stimulus: The employee has extensive successful experience and high credibility on this issue. The employee hints indirectly at the recommendation and uses respectful, courteous language.

low_directness_high_politeness_low_credi.label: low directness / high politeness / low credibility
low_directness_high_politeness_low_credi.stimulus: The employee has limited experience and low credibility on this issue. The employee hints indirectly at the recommendation and uses respectful, courteous language.

low_directness_low_politeness_high_credi.label: low directness / low politeness / high credibility
low_directness_low_politeness_high_credi.stimulus: The employee has extensive successful experience and high credibility on this issue. The employee hints indirectly at the recommendation, using blunt and discourteous language.

low_directness_low_politeness_low_credib.label: low directness / low politeness / low credibility
low_directness_low_politeness_low_credib.stimulus: The employee has limited experience and low credibility on this issue. The employee hints indirectly at the recommendation, using blunt and discourteous language.

materials.response_instruction: Rate every item from 1 (strongly disagree) to 7 (strongly agree) and return only integer item responses.

items.text: The employee voiced the idea directly.
The employee stated the recommendation clearly.
The employee got straight to the point.
The employee can be trusted on this issue.

research_restricted.aligned_hypothesis_text: Under high credibility, direct voice receives more endorsement than indirect voice after averaging over politeness.
research_restricted.reversed_hypothesis_text: Under high credibility, direct voice receives no more endorsement than indirect voice after averaging over politeness.
